We evaluate the efficacy of our approach on standard, large-scale benchmarks and on low-resource scenarios, where the Transformer was shown to induce poorer syntax. Following Bastings et al. (2017), we use News Commentary v11 (NC11) with En-De and De-En tasks to simulate low resources and test multiple source languages. To compare with previous work, we train our models on WMT16 En-De and WAT En-Ja tasks, removing sentences in incorrect languages from WMT16 data sets.
